from z3 import *
import re

pairs=[]
for line in open('/app/pairs.txt'):
    a,b=line.split()
    pairs.append((int(a),int(b)))

def expand(s32):
    return s32 ^ (s32 << 16) ^ (s32 * BitVecVal(12345,32))

def g(a,b,x):
    t = a + b + x
    return RotateLeft(t,2)

def F(inp):
    x=[Extract(8*i+7,8*i,inp) for i in range(4)]
    y=[None]*4
    y[2]=g(x[3]^x[2], x[1]^x[0], BitVecVal(1,8))
    y[3]=g(x[3], y[2], BitVecVal(0,8))
    y[1]=g(x[1]^x[0], y[2], BitVecVal(0,8))
    y[0]=g(x[0], y[1], BitVecVal(1,8))
    out=BitVecVal(0,32)
    for i in range(4):
        out = out | (ZeroExt(24,y[i]) << (8*i))
    return out

s=Solver()
seeds=[BitVec(f'k{i}',20) for i in range(4)]
keys=[expand(ZeroExt(12,z)) for z in seeds]
for p,c in pairs:
    L=BitVecVal((p>>32)&0xffffffff,32)
    R=BitVecVal(p&0xffffffff,32)
    R=R^L
    for r in range(4):
        mixed=F(R^keys[r])
        temp=R
        R=L^mixed
        L=temp
    L=L^R
    CL=R; CR=L
    s.add(CL==BitVecVal((c>>32)&0xffffffff,32))
    s.add(CR==BitVecVal(c&0xffffffff,32))

print(s.check())
m=s.model()
vals=[m.eval(z).as_long() for z in seeds]
print(vals, [hex(v) for v in vals])

M=0xffffffff
def expd(s): return (s ^ ((s<<16)&M) ^ ((s*12345)&M))&M
def g(a,b,x):
    t=(a+b+x)&0xff
    return ((t<<2)|(t>>6))&0xff
def F(v):
    x=[(v>>(8*i))&0xff for i in range(4)]
    y=[0]*4
    y[2]=g(x[3]^x[2],x[1]^x[0],1)
    y[3]=g(x[3],y[2],0)
    y[1]=g(x[1]^x[0],y[2],0)
    y[0]=g(x[0],y[1],1)
    return sum(y[i]<<(8*i) for i in range(4))
seeds=[0x68e63,0x62571,0x1f61c,0xb74a5]
K=[expd(s) for s in seeds]
def enc(p):
    L=(p>>32)&M; R=p&M; R^=L
    for r in range(4):
        mix=F(R^K[r]); temp=R; R=L^mix; L=temp
    L^=R
    return (R<<32)|L
cts=[int(x) for x in open('/app/ciphertexts.txt')]
pts=[int(x) for x in open('/app/plaintexts.txt')]
assert len(cts)==len(pts)
print('all match:', all(enc(p)==c for p,c in zip(pts,cts)))
for line in open('/app/pairs.txt'):
